walkthroughs.body_html:
News often shows religion through dramatic stories — extremism, conflict.

Everyday faith — kindness, charity, family — is less newsworthy. That's misrepresentation.

Many religious groups use social media:

  • Online sermons.
  • Faith podcasts.
  • Online communities for prayer or chat.

Religious influencers reach millions.

Pluralism = many beliefs side by side, common in modern UK.

Tolerance means accepting people whose beliefs differ from yours.

Tolerance, not agreement, is what holds modern societies together. 🤝
